housing: Chicago's rentals are largely two-flats, three-flats and vintage courtyard buildings, plus high-rises along the lake.
climate: Test the heat and photograph windows, radiators and any drafts; winters are long and very cold.
fact: Chicago's ordinance can make a landlord who mishandles a deposit pay up to twice the deposit, so the receipt and move-in record matter.
